# DeepSeek Harness for VS Code
**English** | 简体中文
A native VS Code coding-agent extension powered by DeepSeek Harness. Install the platform-specific V
SIX and start working—there is no upstream repository to clone, no Node/npm setup, and no local Harn
ess deployment to manage.
> Community-maintained **0.6.2 stable extension release**, bundling the official `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0
.2.2-rc.1` package (Typert Remote protocol) and standalone Node `24.22.2`. The bundled DSH runtime i
s a release candidate, and DeepSeek Harness remains a Developer Preview.
This release unifies saved session history with official DSH, groups conversations by their original
project folder, adds native MCP management, and fixes duplicate or out-of-order prompts. See the Ch
inese release notes.
> **Runtime upgrade:** Harness now uses session format V4. Supported older logs are migrated on resu
me into a new generation while their original files are preserved. Old runtimes cannot read the new
V4 generation; back up the shared history home (default `~/.dsh`) and the private `~/.dsh/vscode/har
ness-home` before upgrading, and do not downgrade an active profile. Third-party plugins using the r
emoved `ctx.agent` or runtime `Inbox` APIs need their own compatibility updates. The extension keeps
its native VS Code interface rather than embedding the official Web UI.
Startup uses the official runtime package resolver. Only a recognized legacy module conflict trigger
s one bounded backup-and-repair attempt; ordinary profile packages are no longer moved on every star
tup or installation.
## 0.6.2 release update
This update aligns the workbench with DSH `0.2.2-rc.1`:
- **One saved-history store:** new sessions use the selected shared `sessions/` directory, normally
`~/.dsh/sessions`. Readable legacy histories migrate with their originals retained; an incompatible
record no longer switches the extension to a private store. The history panel shows the actual path

and migration details.
- **Project-based session management:** conversations belong to their origina
l folder across clients. Browse other projects, preview without activating an Agent, and choose **Co
ntinue here** to request native execution ownership. New conversations work directly in the selected

folder; existing worktrees retain manual actions.
- **Native changes and titles:** per-turn snapsho
ts and diffs use `@deepseek-ai/dsh-workspace-changes`. Titles are read from native logs and retained

across partial or stale metadata updates.
- **MCP management:** add, edit, enable, disable and remo
ve stdio or Streamable HTTP servers through **More → MCP servers** or the command palette. Changes a

re validated and wait for idle model turns before reloading the Host.
- **Conversation and compatibi
lity fixes:** attached editor context no longer duplicates prompts after answers; streaming and queu
ed prompts keep their order. The bundled chat importer is updated to `0.26.4`, with known-version up

grades preserving its enabled state.
- **Platform packages:** CI tests and builds `darwin-arm64`, `w
in32-x64`, `linux-x64` and `linux-arm64`. Unused Office preview and experimental voice resources rem
ain excluded; sizes are shown on the release assets.
Download the VSIX from the v0.6.2 release and reload VS Code after installation. GitHub Actions buil
ds and publishes the four platform packages when the release tag is pushed. Marketplace publication
is separate. Release notes are available in Chinese in the changelog.
## Features
- **Native VS Code workbench** — all interaction happens in the sidebar; the local Harness Gateway e

xposes only the loopback API transport, while the official WebUI is neither served nor embedded.
- *
*First-run guidance** — an unconfigured key shows a three-step setup hint with a direct link to conn
ection settings; history previews show the original project and execution directory before continuat

ion.
- **Shared local history** — the bundled runtime and an independently installed official DSH ca
n read the same saved conversations. Installing the official CLI is optional; credentials and plugin

profiles stay separate.
- **Detachable workbench** — open the same synchronized conversation UI in

an editor-area panel and move it to another VS Code window when more space is needed.
- **Complete s
ession workflow** — persistent history, create, switch, rename, fork, resume, archive/restore, expor
t, and import sessions (official DSH ZIP, ChatGPT export ZIP, and other agent transcripts via `dsh-c
hat-import`); a started conversation keeps its preset; model and reasoning choices remain editable,

and another preset requires an explicitly created conversation.
- **Streaming Markdown** — headings,
lists, tables, code blocks, copy controls, safe external links, and clickable workspace file refere

nces.
- **Stable incremental rendering** — streamed updates preserve disclosure state and the reader

's scroll position.
- **Progressive reasoning timeline** — nodes appear as thinking steps arrive, co
nnecting only existing steps within the same turn. Completed turns retain their timeline inside the

expandable process section.
- **Session titles** — automatic titles and manual renames are owned by

the official session service.
[该节后续省略]
## Security and privacy

- The Harness Gateway listens only on a random `127.0.0.1` port.
- The Webview uses a strict CSP and

loads no remote scripts or iframes.
- Plugin catalog JSON is fetched by the Extension Host, validat

ed into a narrow UI data model, and rendered with `textContent`.
- Raw Markdown HTML is disabled, an

d rendered markup is sanitized through a DOMPurify allowlist.
- Remote Markdown images are disabled;

http(s) links are validated again by the extension host.
- File and command access is controlled by

`permissionMode` and Harness approval policies.
- The API Key is never sent to the Webview or writt

en to extension logs.
- Third-party DSH plugins are trusted Extension Host dependencies: they run ou
tside the Agent sandbox. Review their source before installation.
